note: The models the runs use. Keys never go in this file. They live in the macOS Keychain under the names below, copied there by bash owner/keys.sh. Prices are US dollars per million tokens from a check of the vendors' published prices on 2026-11-19. cache_write and cache_read multiply the input price. Sonnet 5.5's cache reads fell to 0.05 times on 2026-10-07, and GPT-6 Luna bills cached input at 0.1 times. Haiku 5.5 costs five times as much on a prompt over 100,000 tokens, which no call here comes near.
route_note: After run 2, the cheapest model that clears every bar in the answer key opens the page. Until then the default does.

models.label: GPT-6 Luna
models.reasoning_note: OpenAI takes function tools on this model's Chat Completions only with reasoning set to none (its answer in run 1's dev round). The Claude models run without extended thinking, and all three work without extended reasoning.
